answer: Require every agent to lock a stake before trading, with trust starting at its nadir: a fresh identity may only handle copper-tier, low-value work. Reputation then grows slowly through verified deliveries, while a downward spiral of slashing cuts the stake of any identity caught misbehaving. Cloning identities gains nothing: each copy restarts at the bottom with its own stake locked, so a sybil attack costs a fresh bond per fake agent plus the time to earn trust, while honest agents keep their accumulated standing.
